content.text:
I changed `UberJarBuilder.java` so the uber jar build no longer hits `ClosedFileSystemException`. I couldn't compile it or run any tests: `mvn -q -o compile` in `core/deployment` stopped on missing dependency versions in the POM.

I couldn't reproduce the failure either, so the cause is inferred from the stack trace. `ParallelCommonsCompressArchiveCreator` reads the file contents lazily, when it is closed. `UberJarBuilder.walkFileDependencyForDependency` opened each dependency's path tree and closed it straight away. Under `--threads`, another module's build can then release the last reference to the shared zip filesystem before the archive is written. The late read then fails.

The fix collects the opened path trees in `buildUberJar0`. It closes them in a `finally` block after the archive creator has closed.

I also didn't check `copyApplicationContent`, which may need the same treatment.
